{{Top}} {{Conjecture}} {{Character |type= |image= |name=Trace and Rafa Martez's mother |homeworld= |birth= |death=[[21 BBY]],According to "[[Dangerous Debt]]," [[Trace Martez|Trace]] and [[Rafa Martez]]'s [[Parent|mother]] [[Death|died]] during [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure]]'s [[Senate hostage crisis|escape]] from [[prison]]. The {{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-chronological-episodeorder|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Chronological Episode Order}} establishes that Ziro's escape in "[[Hostage Crisis]]" took place after the [[Battle of Kamino]] in "[[ARC Troopers (episode)|ARC Troopers]]" but before the events of "[[Heroes on Both Sides]]." Since ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates both events to [[21 BBY]], Trace and Rafa's mother died in 21. "''It's something my mother would have done. She always believed in helping others.|Ahsoka Tano and Trace Martez|}} A '''female individual''' lived in [[the galaxy]] during the [[Republic Era|Age of the Republic]]. [[Gender|She]] was the mother of [[Trace Martez|Trace]] and [[Rafa Martez]], and taught her daughters to help others in need. Trace initially told [[Ahsoka Tano]] that their parents had "split," leaving them the family business, but Rafa later told her that they had been killed during the [[Senate hostage crisis]], when [[Cad Bane]], who she remembered as a "red-eyed alien," had shot down a transport during [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure]]'s escape, which the pursuing Jedi stopped from crashing into a crowded platform, instead causing it to accidentally crash into the [[Martez family]]'s quarters, killing both parents. {{Char-stub}} ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Deal No Deal}} {{1stm}} *{{TCW|Dangerous Debt}} {{Mo}} *{{TCW|Together Again}} {{Imo}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/clone-wars-first-look-dangerous-debt|text=''Clone Wars'' First Look: "Dangerous Debt"}} *{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/dangerous-debt-episode-guide|text="Dangerous Debt" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Martez, Trace and Rafa's mother}} [[Category:Coruscanti]] [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified species]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]]
